ev-costco-automotive-batteries.title: Costco.com: Interstate Car & Truck Batteries (automotive battery page and FAQ)
ev-costco-automotive-batteries.quote: Costco Automotive Batteries are supported by a 36 Month Limited Prorated Warranty. … Costco Interstate batteries offer the same reliable power as Interstate batteries, but a different warranty program supports them.
ev-costco-automotive-batteries.note: Read in Chrome, opening each FAQ answer. The page sells Interstate only, for cars, trucks, boats, RVs, golf carts and mowers, and has no phone price line. Its FAQ explains the core charge (a deposit refunded when you bring the old battery back), gives do-it-yourself fitting steps, and reads the date code as a month letter (A = January) plus a year digit (1 = 2021), the date the battery "was shipped from the manufacturing plant".

source.name: Costco.com listings
source.publisher: Costco Wholesale Corporation (owner of Kirkland Signature)
source.cannot_prove: Who builds the batteries, or where: the page names only the Interstate brand, and it can change without notice.

ev-sec-clarios-s1a-2023.title: Clarios International Inc., Form S-1/A (Amendment No. 6), filed 15 Dec 2023

ev-sec-clarios-s1a-2023.note: Per the filing, Clarios is the Power Solutions business of Johnson Controls, bought by a group led by Brookfield Business Partners on 30 April 2019. The prospectus also names Interstate first among its "longstanding" aftermarket customers. It names the Interstate brand, not each battery, and doesn't mention Costco. Clarios's credit agreements filed with the same registration (2020, 2023) say Interstate Batteries is not to be treated as an affiliate. This is the newest amendment of the registration we found.

ev-ford-9400-age.title: Ford distributor manual, Section 9400, page 7: warranty age
ev-ford-9400-age.quote: Use the battery shipping date code to determine the age of the battery.

The customer must have the warranty sticker, its serial number must match the one on the battery cover, and any allowance goes toward a new Motorcraft battery. A warranty instruction to distributors. cite.note: The post says most flooded batteries and REDTOPs should read about 12.6 to 12.8 volts fully charged, and YELLOWTOPs about 13.0 to 13.2.

source.name: OPTIMA
source.cannot_prove: Which plant built one battery, or anything about a store brand it does not name.

cite.title: Trojan Battery: battery maintenance
cite.quote: VRLA batteries should not be stored for more than 6 months
cite.note: The page also says to charge stored batteries fully every 3 to 6 months. These are mostly deep-cycle batteries.

source.name: Trojan
source.cannot_prove: Which plant built one battery, or anything about a store brand it does not name.

cite.title: ACDelco Canada: Battery warranty
cite.quote: Example: S 040 G – is a Silver Series dated April of 2020
cite.note: It is the Canadian site, and it says the code is used when there is no receipt. It points to a chart for older branding that we could not read as text. It says the code stands in for a receipt at the discretion of the parts supplier or repair facility, and that G is Gold and S is Silver or Advantage.

source.name: ACDelco
source.cannot_prove: Which plant built one battery, or anything about a store brand it does not name.

cite.title: ACDelco Battery Warranty Information, revised 2-11-15: no bill of sale
cite.quote: the beginning date for this warranty will be based on the date code as it appears on the battery label
cite.note: Applies when the dated bill of sale isn't available. Read on Delcoline's copy.

source.name: ACDelco warranty sheet
source.cannot_prove: Whether today's labels follow the same format, or which plant built one battery. We read a copy on a distributor's site.

cite.title: Ford distributor manual, Section 9400, page 7: warranty age
cite.quote: Use the battery shipping date code to determine the age of the battery.
cite.note: From the section on lost proof-of-purchase receipts. The customer must have the warranty sticker, its serial number must match the one on the battery cover, and any allowance goes toward a new Motorcraft battery. A warranty instruction to distributors. Page 8, effective October 2010, calls a battery new defective if it was never placed into service and is under six months old by that code. That is a warranty class, not a shelf limit.

source.name: Ford distributor manual
source.cannot_prove: How a label printed today looks, or how old one battery is. The pages are dated 2002 to 2010, and we read a copy on a distributor's site.

cite.title: Ford distributor manual, Section 9400, page 4: stock checks
cite.quote: Batteries found to have voltage readings below 12.40 volts (O.C.V.) should be recharged.
cite.note: The same page says voltage should be checked at least every 90 days and that older stock should be sold first.

source.name: Ford distributor manual
source.cannot_prove: How a label printed today looks, or how old one battery is. The pages are dated 2002 to 2010, and we read a copy on a distributor's site.

cite.title: It Still Runs: How to check the date of a Motorcraft battery
cite.quote: On a Motorcraft battery, this is located on the side of the battery case
cite.note: A how-to article by Anthony Smith, updated June 29, 2023. It gives A to L and a year digit, with C8 as March 2008, and cites no source. Used only because we found no rule from Ford or Motorcraft.

source.name: It Still Runs
source.cannot_prove: That a maker uses the rule. The article cites no sources.
